title: The Locator Forest
tagline: Finding the right element among hundreds - and only that one.
teaches: Locator priority order, chaining, filtering, strict mode, actionability
objectives: Choose a locator from the priority order instead of grabbing the first thing that works
Scope a search to part of the page by chaining locators
Recognise a strict-mode violation and fix the cause rather than the symptom
Explain why Playwright refuses to click an element that something is covering
